resources.string: One click opens a file, already presented spatially; Save writes back to the same file
Nothing opened yet. Use New to start a file, or Browse to find files on this device.
Next: choose New on the left to start a document, or click a file to open it.
No cloud drive connected. Connect one under Accounts & drives; local files are not affected.
Files open here from other places too
Browser downloads · system Share and Open with. One click opens them; nothing is converted first.
New files are standard .docx / .xlsx / .pptx in Documents/SpatialOffice; other software opens them directly
.docx / .xlsx / .pptx are open international standard formats (ISO/IEC 29500). New files are saved in them directly; there is no app-specific format.
This device and connected drives. Save writes back in place
No files that can be opened in this folder
Only files this app created are visible
Allow “All files access” to list files that other apps put in Download and Documents. Or use “Open file…” to pick a single file.
Optional. Local files open, edit and save without any account
What the app can do once connected

Browse your folders, open the files you pick and save changes back in place. Approval happens on the provider’s own page; your password never passes through this app. The token is encrypted on this device and deleted on sign-out.
Window: beside other apps. Spread out: enters Full Space and hides other apps for now
Neither changes the file. With the file: a same-named .spatial.json is placed beside it
Back up the original before the first save
Keeps “name (original)” beside the file once; never repeated
Default radius for new layouts; each file can override it
With keyboard and mouse, hands, or a controller
Keyboard and mouse are the main input; controller, hand ray and gaze-pinch work too
Version %1$s · compatible with .docx / .xlsx / .pptx (open standard) · local files work fully offline; accounts are optional
File format and cloud service names are used only to describe compatibility and connections. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by their owners.
All windows will close. %1$s has unsaved changes that will be lost.
Look at the row and pinch
Point the ray at the row and pull the trigger
Click and type; in a sheet, arrow keys move and Enter confirms
Pinch the place to edit and type on the system keyboard
Trigger on the place to edit and type on the system keyboard
Ctrl+S, or [Save] on the bottom toolbar
Trigger on [Save] on the bottom toolbar
Click [Spread out]; Ctrl+Alt+← → changes the piece in front; Esc collapses
Pinch [Spread out]; pinch a piece to bring it in front; pinch [Collapse]
Trigger on [Spread out]; trigger on a piece to bring it in front; trigger on [Collapse]
Drag the small dot under the window
Pinch and drag the small dot under the window
Hold the trigger on the small dot under the window and drag
In a sheet click Chart and pick column, line, pie or 3D; in 3D click a bar to select its cell
Pinch Chart and pick one; in 3D pinch a bar to select its cell
Trigger on Chart and pick one; in 3D trigger on a bar to select its cell
Spread: change the piece in front
%1$s · nothing in the file is dropped
Everything in this file can be shown and edited here.
Columns → shown as one column here
The file keeps its columns; it is unchanged on a computer.
Text box → shown inline in reading order
The text box keeps its position in the file; it is just not shown floating here.
Missing font → shown in a system font
The font name in the file is unchanged.
Shown as a read-only block. Untouched in the file.
Read-only, shown in their final form. The changes stay in the file.
Not shown here. They stay in the file.
Shown as a read-only block here; charts in a spreadsheet can be viewed in 3D. Untouched in the file.
Read-only in this version. Untouched in the file.
Not shown or read-only here. Untouched in the file; saving never alters it.
An object that cannot be shown here yet
It stays untouched in the file; saving never alters it.
Keep the layout with the file…
This file has no backed-up original yet
Placed %1$s beside the file; the file itself is unchanged
Cannot write beside the file here; the layout stays on this headset
Type a value, text, or a formula starting with =
Sorted the data rows by column %1$s
Formulas in these rows point at other rows; nothing was sorted
No chart in this sheet yet. Select a block of data (first row = categories, first column = series names) and click again to create a standard chart.
Created the standard chart “%1$s”; it is written to the file on save
Cannot chart this block: it needs at least two rows and two columns
Blue: data range %2$s of the chart “%1$s”. Change a number and the 3D chart follows
%1$s · edit a cell and the bar follows
Click a bar to select its cell
Click a dot to select its row
Speaker notes (float on your left during rehearsal)
What you will say on this slide
An object whose content cannot be shown here yet (it can be moved and resized; its content is untouched)
Entered Full Space: other apps’ windows are hidden until you tap Collapse
Layout recorded (file untouched); restored next time
This is the first save of this file, so the original is backed up first. Saving only touches what you changed.
→ written back in place in the file; other software opens and edits it as usual
Everything else, including objects that are read-only or not shown here
→ not written into the file. Kept on this headset and restored next time
A backup cannot be placed beside this file; it goes to the app\'s own folder: %1$s
This kind of file cannot be opened here
Everything is here · %1$d shown approximately · %2$d read-only. Opening never changes the file
First save: the file is named after its first line, %1$s
The empty new file was not kept
Same content as now; other software opens it directly
Fixed layout, good for sending to others
Values and text only; formulas become their results
Placed in a folder named after the file
The file you are editing is not affected
Without saving, these changes are lost.
No permission to read or write this location
No file picker on this device. Find the file under Browse.
This kind of file is read-only: view, spread out, save as
Connected. Go back to Spatial Office; you can close this page.
Sign-in expired. Changes stay on this device and are saved once you sign in again
Sign-in expired. Nothing is lost; sign in again, then save
No browser on this device can open the sign-in page
Not connected. Connect opens the browser to sign in; your password never passes through this app
Access was revoked and the token deleted. Changes stay on this device
Signed out of %1$s; the token is deleted
This device cannot store the sign-in token
Waiting for you to approve in the browser… (valid for 10 minutes)
Sign-in expired; your changes are kept on this device. Sign in again, then save
Cannot reach the service. Open files can still be edited; save once you are online
This file is read-only in the cloud (Google’s own formats, Feishu slides). Use Save as to keep a copy
Not saved: %1$s. Your changes are still here; try again
Feishu slides are read-only in this version; opened in the browser
Pick a value in a data row first, then filter by it
“%1$s” is not a picture that can be inserted
No pictures found in Pictures, Download, Camera or Documents. Try System picker…
Newest pictures from Pictures, Download, Camera and Documents
Goes to the top of the drive; this file is not touched
The sign-in token on this device is deleted. Changes not yet saved stay here and can be saved after you connect the same account again.
Sorted the data rows by column %1$s, descending
Ctrl+B / I / U; select text, then Text sets size and strikethrough, Colour sets colour and highlight; Tab / Shift+Tab change a list item\'s level
Pinch to select text, then pinch a toolbar button or menu item
Trigger-drag to select text, then trigger on a toolbar button or menu item
Ctrl+F; or More › Find and replace / Word count
Pinch More, then Find and replace or Word count
Trigger on More, then Find and replace or Word count
Hold a thumbnail on the left and drag it; or Slide › Move up / down
Pinch and hold a thumbnail, then drag; let go to drop it
Hold the trigger on a thumbnail, then drag; release to drop it
Home › Accounts & drives › Connect: the browser opens the sign-in page and comes back once you approve; then switch Browse to that drive
Pinch Connect and approve on the browser page that opens; back here, pinch a file under Browse
Trigger on Connect and approve on the browser page that opens; back here, trigger on a file under Browse
Open a .docx / .xlsx / .pptx and save back to the same file
Documents you put here from your computer
Scan with your phone or computer
The headset only shows a code; you agree on the other device
Sign in in the headset browser
Opens the service’s own sign-in page, then comes back here
You never type a password here
Scan this with %1$s or the camera on your phone, then tap Agree there
Or open %1$s on a computer and enter this code
Waiting for you to agree on the other device… (%1$d:%2$02d left)
Your sign-in is kept encrypted on this headset and deleted when you sign out
Save as to Feishu puts files in the %1$s folder
The inbox is %1$s / %2$s: documents you put there from your computer show at the top of Recent
Someone (or you on another device) saved this file after you opened it. Saving now would replace those changes
Not saved; your changes are still here
New files and copies you save go here
Pick it in the system file picker; it still saves back to where it was
Your drive’s folders and files, with Spatial Office / Inbox at the top. Tap a file to open it; saving puts it back where it was
Your drive’s folders and files. Tap a file to open it; saving puts it back in place and the drive keeps a version
Without any account you can open, edit and save under Device
Feishu would not update this file in place. “%1$s” is left as it was; your changes were saved as “%2$s” beside it, and later saves go to that copy.
If Feishu won’t update a Drive file in place, the original stays as it is and your edits go to “name (Spatial Office copy)” beside it; a dialog tells you
%1$d files of this kind are open already. Close one first
Click to pick, hold and drag to move; drag a corner dot to resize. In a document, click a picture or table, then drag a corner
Look at it, pinch and drag; to resize, pinch a corner dot and drag
Point the ray at it, hold the trigger and drag; to resize, hold a corner dot and drag
Click more files under Recent or Browse: each opens in its own window and nothing is replaced. New windows open in front; switch under Windows n in the title bar, or go Home there
Pinch Windows n in the title bar, then a file; for side by side choose Side by side, or pinch the small dot under a window and move it aside
Trigger on Windows n in the title bar, then on a file; for side by side choose Side by side, or hold the small dot under a window and move it aside
Picked: drag to move, drag a corner dot to resize
%1$d more open behind; switch under Windows in the title bar
Sign in and approve on the service’s own page; it then comes back here. You never type a password in this app
Files on this device. Saving writes back to where the file came from
Version %1$s · compatible with .docx / .xlsx / .pptx (open standard) · local files work fully offline
File format names are used only to describe compatibility. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by their owners.
Your unsaved changes are back; you can undo it
This draft could not be opened and was removed
\"%1$s\" was closed last time with changes that were not saved. Get them back?
Cut %1$s; it is emptied when you paste
Everything on this sheet goes with it. Formulas on other sheets that use it will show #REF!.
There is a sheet with that name already
Copied; go to a slide and choose Insert › Paste
Charts and similar objects cannot be copied in this version
Every save keeps a version, up to %1$d, on this device only.
No saved versions yet. Save once and one shows up here.
That version is back. Save to write it to the file; Undo takes it back.
That neighbour spans different rows or columns, so they can\'t merge.
